listing.name: Gears of War 3 — gow3-recomp (Flippage)
listing.summary: Upstream reports startup, menus, early campaign chapters, saved checkpoints and local two-instance System Link co-op. A full campaign, internet co-op, Horde, Beast, Versus and AMD FSR remain untested. Portcove has not confirmed the release or expanded keybindings. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own base-disc Gears of War 3 folder containing default.xex and GearGame: title ID 4D5308AB, disc version 0.0.0.11, media ID 58122AD6. Keep these files available while playing. Title updates are unsupported.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract gow3-recomp-0.1.0-win64.zip, follow its QUICKSTART and point gow3_game_path.txt at your own game folder. GitHub lists 47571151 bytes and SHA-256 f5faf42b9ac5d5b1f4c0236b7f454de1dd43f30da5309ddb6e4d84d5bcc9ee55; Portcove has not checked the package bytes or run it. The release omits DLSS; that optional feature requires a local Windows source build.

warnings: Upstream reports startup, menus, early campaign chapters, saved checkpoints and local two-instance System Link co-op. A full campaign, internet co-op, Horde, Beast, Versus and AMD FSR remain untested. Portcove has not confirmed the release or expanded keybindings.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
